access: Actual current public Craft of Exile beta UI through Codex browser. No game purchases or trading. No source Sheet edits.

startingItem.procurement: Buy an already qualified rare fractured base. Setting up the simulator input is not a free in-game fracture operation or proof of an executed purchase.

requirements.otherRequirements: The acquired fracture is retained, and the selected Deafening Essence guarantees the remaining target modifier; no open affix, bench, Eldritch implicit or finishing requirement.

successfulOutcome.evidenceKind: Simulate this outcome generated the complete selected bundle. This proves reachability, not empirical spending or sale.

ordinaryPaidReroll.outcome: REJECT: life >=100 missing; pay another essence on the same base

baseConsumption.basis: The essence reroll retained the pre-acquired fracture, base identity, item level and influence state in the ordinary paid action; no base destruction/replacement stage is included.

limits: Displayed probability and mean uses are rounded CoE model values, not observed in-game craft frequencies. Costs based on the rounded mean are indicative.
Acquisition price must come from fresh eligible base asks, not the simulator setup or its internal default prices. Gold fees, completed sales, liquidity and build equivalence are unverified.
The complex minion-Leviathan/Fear/bench/Ember chain is different and does not inherit this single-stage expected count.
